# New armor: Rage, Bulwark, Wayward, Wild Accident and more

![New armor: Rage, Bulwark, Wayward, Wild Accident and more](/uploads/665_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In the update “The Hinterland” on March 3rd, 2026, some proper name armors were revised and new ones were added. In most cases, these are chest pieces of armor that have a special effect and are only available as rewards at certain events and quests. There are no sets of this armor and the legendary mods cannot be changed. All are tradable.

## [New] Rage

- Chest part
- Type: Raider Armor
- Can drop as light, medium and heavy armor
- Levels: 5 / 15 / 25 / 35 / 45
- Tradeable
- Legendary mods
 - **Auto-Voice**
 - **Pain relievers**
 - **Burning**
- Unique Effect:
 - **When hit, you deal +1% damage and take +1% damage, up to 100%. Stacks expire over time if you don't take damage.**
 - Stacks expire 1 stack per 30 seconds. So 100 stacks expire after 50 minutes.
 - Stacks can be created by damaging enemies or self-inflicted damage. e.g. 100 shots on the floor with the thirst quencher (water pistol) are enough to build up the stacks.
 - The stacks continue to count even if you do not have the armor permanently equipped. There is a background mechanic for this.
 - Rage Armor Test Video from Angry Turtle
- Reward in:
 - Event: **A Colossal Problem** (5% Drop Chance)
- Events: 

![Rage Armor](/uploads/nukaknights-post-unique-armor-patch66-rage-light.jpg)

## [New] Bulwark

- Chest part
- Type: Secret Service Armor
- Level: 40 / 50
- Tradeable
- Legendary Mods:
 - **The Killer**
 - **Elementalist**
 - **Adamantium**
- Unique Effect:
 - **This armor weighs twice as much and provides 35% more protection.**
- Reward in:
 - Event: **Neurological Warfare** (5% drop chance)
- Events: 

![Bulwark Armor](/uploads/nukaknights-post-unique-armor-patch66-bulwark50.jpg)

## Waykeeper

- Chest part
- Metal armor
- Can drop as light, medium and heavy armor
- Levels: 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50
- Tradeable
- Legendary Mods:
 - **The Hunter**
 - **Perception**
 - **The Thru-Hiker**
- Unique Effect:
 - **+50% damage with thrown weapons.**
 - This bonus applies to Throwing Knife, Tomahawk, Sheepsquatch Shard and Meat Cleaver.
- Reward at:
 - Quest: **Tourism Office** (100% drop chance)
 - **Danger of collapse terminal**
(100% drop chance with 100 mining tokens of the event: Danger of Collapse)
-Quest: 

![Wegewart Armor](/uploads/nukaknights-post-unique-armor-patch66-trail-warden.jpg) 

## Steadfast

- Chest part
- Type: Battle Armor
- Can drop as light, medium and heavy armor
- Levels: 20 / 30 / 40 / 50
- Tradeable
- Legendary Mods:
 - **Chameleon**
 - **Tough**
 - **The Guardian**
- Unique Effect:
 - **Armor increases with speed (up to +50).**
 - The movement speed bonus limit is now 150%, so you can increase your movement speed by 50% through perks and mods. At +50% you get +50 more damage resistance with this armor.
- Reward in:
 - Event: **A Night of Violence** (80% drop chance)
 - Quest: **Early Warning** (100% chance)
- Events: 

![Standfast Armor](/uploads/nukaknights-post-unique-armor-patch66-stand-fast.jpg)

## A silver lining

- Chest part
- Type: Leather Armor
- Levels: 1 / 5 / 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50
- Can drop as light, medium and heavy armor
- Tradeable
- Legendary Mods:
 - **Life-saving**
 - **Endurance**
 - **Belted**
- Unique Effect:
 - **Reflects 10% of damage.**
- Reward in:
 - Quest: **Non-binding plans** (100% drop chance)
 - Activity: **Storm and Clean** - Mother Lode Container:
